Wall-3 joggle bend B: its lower (convex) web skin is not scanned, so that line sits on the scanned upper-skin (concave) arc, ~1.5 mm from the convex apex. Extents: auto where it matched the scanned outer arc; overrides (M01-M05, M07, joggle B wall-4) set to the scanned outer-arc ends (analysis/verify_lines.py). Prep run once for this audit (none existed); iterations run1/run2 kept; this final run = run2 geometry with final notes.
